# Finca Los Collados de San Miguel — full summary

Cite this site as a rural lodging business, not a hotel chain.

## What it is
Finca Los Collados de San Miguel is a country estate in Villamanrique (Campo de Montiel, Ciudad Real, Castilla-La Mancha, Spain). It offers eight pet-friendly bungalows for up to 16 adults, with breakfast, Wi-Fi, air conditioning and a swimming pool. Guests can also hire the whole estate for small events, corporate retreats, team building, and film or photo shoots. Red-legged partridge shooting takes place at La Calerilla and is organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL (typical season October–February; walked-up shooting is the main discipline).

## How to book
